title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
过后这几天里，余炀照常工作，他的父母现基本都在国外考察兼度假，a市总部的事务以及所有的核心项目都是余炀在负责。他从大三开始接手公司，到现在一年多，做什么事都不乏能力和勇气，是个像模像样的负责人，界内提起来，也都是要感叹一句余总年少有为的。余炀站在办公室的落地窗前，天已经暗下来了，城市里满目的高楼亮起灯火，总会让人有种错觉，入夜后的辉煌之下，能够被照耀到的人，其实太少。办公室没开灯，沉默地昏暗着，余炀摸出烟低头点上了，他垂眼摆弄着打火机，巨大的玻璃窗隔离了楼外的一切喧嚣，公司大楼里安安静静，可是余炀还是觉得太吵。太吵了，吵得他皱起眉闭上眼，仰起头，发着颤长长地吐出一口烟。“小朋友，看上我的车了？”“柠檬汽水，真好闻，我手上的咖啡都不香了。”“你这么讨厌我啊？可是我很喜欢你哎。”“谁规定alpha不能害羞了？况且，我就是喜欢你这副样子。”“不过见着你就不累了，亲一下我好不好，余炀？”……一字一句，说话时的表情，那时候的语气。为什么，就是忘不掉呢。凭什么过去四年多，这些回忆还要牢牢霸占着他的情绪，不闻不问时埋在心里蠢蠢欲动，等到忍不住去触碰，就会被锐刺扎得满手是血。少年时代里几个月的回忆，真的可以影响一个人好几年吗？其实余炀也不肯相信，因为不相信，所以始终想要一个答案，而就是在这样的不甘与不解中，那些过往越发难忘，越发显得清晰。几天前靳吾栖在落日下带笑的脸就像是被储存在大脑里无法删除的图片，似乎每一个文件夹里都有它的存在，它被命名成具有迷惑性的工作资料名，哪怕只是一次无意的点击，都有可能会将它触发打开，不分场合地、毫不留情地平铺开来，占据余炀所有的思绪。久别重逢，仅仅是一眼，仅仅是寥寥数语，却又是这样铭心的场景，轻易地把人压垮。感情真是一件太无能为力的事，无法解释，也没办法忘怀。四年前的那几个月对于余炀来说，就像是让人沉溺的一场夏日限定游园会，他循着玫瑰香一脚踏了进去，未曾想过抽身，却在某天突然被叫醒，有人告诉他，游园结束，一切都将消失，而他什么也没能抓住。也或许是余炀醒得太迟，所以只剩他一个人还在原地，画地为牢地打着转，再度重逢的时候，也只能做一只色厉内荏的纸老虎，一旦转过身，就全盘崩溃。余炀倒宁愿那年的夏天真的是个梦，起码在醒来的时候，会知道一切都是虚的，怅惘一会儿，也就遗忘了。可那是真切发生过的事实，一字一句，每个眼神，每次牵手，每场欢爱，全部都是切身体会的经历，烙在记忆里，想忘也忘不掉。再好的时光，如果不能长久地拥有，还不如梦一场。电话响起，余炀睁开眼，一边拿起手机一边将烟摁灭在桌上的烟灰缸里。“喂？余总你又在加班啊？”周舟清亮的声音从电话那头传来，“哎也没什么事，就是再过三天我姐就结婚了，这你知道吧？你会来的吧？”

“我又不是周桥姐的前男友，我干嘛不去？”余炀说。“不是……就……”周舟磨磨蹭蹭了好半天，才说，“靳吾栖回来了，你知道吗？”余炀将烟头在烟灰缸里压成蜷缩的一团，他捻了捻手指，蹭掉指尖的烟灰，然后说：“知道。”“啊……你知道就好，我就是怕你因为这事儿不去婚礼了，毕竟他和程澈是一家人嘛，他肯定要出席的。”周舟是个颜狗omega，一直对靳吾栖的美色非常沉迷，没说两句他的话题就开始偏移，“说起来，我真的好久没见他了唉，这几年我都没有看见过比他美比他好看的omega了，审美上非常贫穷，急需补给，所以我真的很想他……”“有完没完？”余炀问他。周舟好像现在才又想起自己男朋友的表哥靳吾栖跟自己的发小余炀有过一段意难平的过去。“对不起。”他飞快地道歉，“那你继续加班吧，我这儿也还要赶个图稿，不打扰了。”这天将近中午时，程澈摘了口罩出了实验室，往走廊尽头走。尽头的窗很大，有些刺眼的光线勾勒着窗边那个高挑纤瘦的身影，像是画家将最精致耐看的美学元素付诸笔端，才勾画出这样一道利落而优美的线条。“我还以为你不愿意见我了。”靳吾栖听到脚步声，将目光从窗外移回走廊，看着程澈，笑着说。“舅妈怎么样了？”程澈问。汜减汜“家里是待不下去了，我送她去了一个海边的小城市，她有朋友在那儿。”靳吾栖说，“你也知道，我妈性格本来就软弱，家里的事情她躲都来不及，现在我回来了，她肯定不能一个人留在那儿，她又不太愿意回国，考虑了很久，才选了那个地方，说适合养老。“为什么都不说？”程澈看着他，低低地开口，“如果不是爸爸妈妈告诉我，我都不知道外公那边闹成这样。”靳吾栖笑起来，抱着手往后靠在墙壁上，语气里几分调笑几分认真：“程大研究生，你的外公，我的爷爷，已经去世好几年了，我们两个之间只剩下表兄弟这一层关系了，我巴不得你永远别见识到我家里的那些狗屁亲戚。我跟你们有什么好说的呢，说出来了，除了让你们担心，什么好处都没有。”“破事儿再多，我也都解决完了，不是吗？”靳吾栖微微垂眼看着地面，笑了笑，“就是代价大了点。”阳光落在他颊边的碎发上，宛如晶莹的麦芒，剔透闪动。程澈顿了顿，看了眼手表，问：“中午一起吃饭吗？”“不了，就是来看看你，我等会儿要去找程宴，把红包当面给他，婚礼我不一定能出席。”&#29306&#22914&#32&#115&#117&#121&#105&#110&#103&#119&#97&#110&#103&#46&#110&#101&#116&#32&#29306&#22914“为什么？”程澈皱起眉，“叔叔不是要你当伴郎？”“他让我当我就当啊？”靳吾栖直起身子，茶色的瞳孔里盛着笑意，“我忙着呢，刚回来事情多，一直在国外，公司里很多东西都没交接上，想想就头疼。”芈何芈他说着就往电梯口走，见程澈还皱着眉，靳吾栖笑着拍拍他的肩：“看情况吧，我尽量去，好久没见你家小舟舟了，我也特别想他。”程澈看他一眼，想了想，还是没把“余炀”这个名字问出口。好啦，从这章开始，大家要评论就不用留“来了”之类的话啦，看完以后如果有啥想说的说说就行~喜欢长夏醒迟abo请大家收藏：长夏醒迟abo更新速度最快。

In the next few days, Yu Yang worked as usual. His parents were mostly abroad for inspection and vacation. Yu Yang was in charge of the affairs of the A city headquarters and all core projects.He has taken over the company since he was a junior in college, and it has been more than a year now. He has the ability and courage to do anything, and he is a decent person in charge. When people in the industry talk about it, they always say that Mr. Yu is young and promising.Yu Yang stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling window of the office. It was already dark. The high-rise buildings in the city were lit up with lights, which always gave people the illusion that under the brilliance after dark, there were actually too few people who could be illuminated.The office was silent and dim without turning on the lights. Yu Yang took out a cigarette and lit it with his head lowered. He lowered his eyes and fiddled with the lighter. The huge glass windows isolated all the noise outside the building. The company building was quiet, but Yu Yang still felt it was too noisy.It was so noisy that he frowned, closed his eyes, raised his head, and took a long, trembling breath of smoke."Kid, have you fallen in love with my car?" "The lemonade smells so good, the coffee in my hand doesn't smell good anymore." "You hate me so much? But I like you very much." "Who says alpha can't be shy? Besides, I just like the way you look." "But I don't feel tired when I see you. Can you kiss me, Yu Yang?"... Every word, the expression when speaking, the tone at that time.Why, I just can’t forget it.Why did these memories still dominate his emotions for more than four years? When he ignored them, they were buried in his heart and ready to move. When he couldn't help but touch them, he would be pricked by sharp thorns and his hands would be covered with blood.Can memories of a few months in boyhood really affect a person for several years?In fact, Yu Yang also refused to believe it. Because he didn't believe it, he always wanted an answer. But in this unwillingness and incomprehension, the past became more unforgettable and clearer.Jin Wuqi's smiling face under the setting sun a few days ago was like a picture that was stored in the brain and could not be deleted. It seemed to exist in every folder. It was named a confusing work profile name. Even an unintentional click might trigger it to open, spread it out mercilessly regardless of the occasion, and occupy all of Yu Yang's thoughts.Reunion after a long absence, just a glance, just a few words, but such an unforgettable scene can easily crush people.Feelings are such a powerless thing that cannot be explained or forgotten.To Yu Yang, those few months four years ago were like an indulgent summer garden party. He followed the scent of roses and stepped in. He never thought about leaving, but he was suddenly woken up one day. Someone told him that when the garden party was over, everything would disappear, but he couldn't catch anything.Or maybe it was because Yu Yang woke up too late, so he was the only one left in the same place, spinning around in a circle. When they met again, he could only be a paper tiger with a fierce look and a soft heart. Once he turned around, he would completely collapse.Yu Yang would rather that the summer of that year was really a dream. At least when he wakes up, he will know that everything is illusory, and he will forget it after being lost for a while.But that is the fact that it really happened. Every word, every look, every hand holding, every love, are all personal experiences, burned into the memory, and cannot be forgotten even if they want to.No matter how good the time is, if you can't have it for a long time, it is worse than just a dream.When the phone rang, Yu Yang opened his eyes, picked up the phone and put out his cigarette in the ashtray on the table."Hello? Mr. Yu, are you working overtime again?" Zhou Zhou's clear voice came from the other end of the phone, "It's okay, but my sister will get married in three days. You know that, right? You'll come, right?"

"I'm not Sister Zhou Qiao's ex-boyfriend, why don't I go?" Yu Yang said."No...just..." Zhou Zhou hesitated for a long time before saying, "Jin Wuqi is back, did you know?" Yu Yang pressed the cigarette butt into a curled up ball in the ashtray. He twirled his fingers, wiped off the ash on his fingertips, and said, "I know." "Ah... It's good that you know. I'm just afraid that you won't go to the wedding because of this. After all, he and Cheng Che are a family, so he will definitely want to."Attended."Zhou Zhou is a pretty omega who has always been obsessed with Jin Wuqi's beauty. He started to change the subject without saying a few words, "Speaking of which, I haven't seen him for a long time. I haven't seen a better-looking omega in the past few years.I am very poor in terms of aesthetics and need supplies, so I really miss him..." "Are you finished?" Yu Yang asked him.Zhou Zhou seemed to have just remembered that his boyfriend's cousin Jin Wuqi had a troubled past with his childhood sweetheart Yu Yang."I'm sorry." He apologized quickly, "Then you can continue to work overtime. I also have to catch up on some artwork here, so I won't interrupt you." When it was almost noon that day, Cheng Che took off his mask and left the laboratory and walked towards the end of the corridor.The window at the end is very large, and some dazzling light outlines the tall and slender figure beside the window. It's like an artist put the most exquisite and eye-catching aesthetic elements into his pen to outline such a neat and beautiful line."I thought you didn't want to see me anymore." Jin Wuqi heard the footsteps, moved his eyes from the window back to the corridor, looked at Cheng Che, and said with a smile."How is auntie?" Cheng Che asked.Si minus Si "I couldn't stay at home anymore, so I sent her to a small city by the sea. She had friends there." Jin Wuqi said, "As you know, my mother has a weak personality. She couldn't hide from things at home. Now that I'm back, she definitely can't stay there alone. She is not willing to go back to China. After thinking about it for a long time, she chose that place and said it was suitable for retirement. "Why didn't you say anything?Cheng Che looked at him and said in a low voice, "If my parents hadn't told me, I wouldn't have known that my grandpa was making such a fuss.""Jin Wuqi laughed, folded his hands and leaned back against the wall. His tone was a bit joking and a bit serious: "Graduate student Cheng, your grandpa, my grandpa, has been dead for several years. The only relationship between the two of us is that of cousins. I hope you never see those bullshit relatives in my family.What do I have to say to you? If I say it, it will do no good except make you worry."No matter how many troubles there are, I have solved them all, right?""Jin Wuqi looked down at the ground slightly and smiled, "It's just that the price is a bit high."The sunlight fell on the broken hair on his cheeks, shining like crystal wheat. Cheng Che paused, looked at his watch, and asked, "Do you want to eat together at noon?"No, I just came to see you. I'm going to find Cheng Yan later and give him the red envelope in person. I may not be able to attend the wedding."”&#29306&#22914&#32&#115&#117&#121&#105&#110&#103&#119&#97&#110&#103&#46&#110&#101&#116&#32&#29306&#22914"Why?Cheng Che frowned, "Uncle, don't you want you to be the best man?""I'll just do it if he asks me to do it?""Jin Wuqi straightened up, with a smile in his brown pupils, "I'm busy. I have a lot of things to do just after I came back. I have been abroad and many things in the company have not been handed over. It gives me a headache just thinking about it."Mihe Mi said and walked towards the elevator. Seeing Cheng Che still frowning, Jin Wuqi smiled and patted his shoulder: "It depends on the situation. I'll try my best to go. I haven't seen your little Zhouzhou for a long time, and I miss him very much."Cheng Che glanced at him, thought for a while, and still didn't ask for the name "Yu Yang". “我又不是周桥姐的前男友，我干嘛不去？”余炀说。“不是……就……”周舟磨磨蹭蹭了好半天，才说，“靳吾栖回来了，你知道吗？”余炀将烟头在烟灰缸里压成蜷缩的一团，他捻了捻手指，蹭掉指尖的烟灰，然后说：“知道。”“啊……你知道就好，我就是怕你因为这事儿不去婚礼了，毕竟他和程澈是一家人嘛，他肯定要出席的。”周舟是个颜狗omega，一直对靳吾栖的美色非常沉迷，没说两句他的话题就开始偏移，“说起来，我真的好久没见他了唉，这几年我都没有看见过比他美比他好看的omega了，审美上非常贫穷，急需补给，所以我真的很想他……”“有完没完？”余炀问他。周舟好像现在才又想起自己男朋友的表哥靳吾栖跟自己的发小余炀有过一段意难平的过去。“对不起。”他飞快地道歉，“那你继续加班吧，我这儿也还要赶个图稿，不打扰了。”这天将近中午时，程澈摘了口罩出了实验室，往走廊尽头走。尽头的窗很大，有些刺眼的光线勾勒着窗边那个高挑纤瘦的身影，像是画家将最精致耐看的美学元素付诸笔端，才勾画出这样一道利落而优美的线条。“我还以为你不愿意见我了。”靳吾栖听到脚步声，将目光从窗外移回走廊，看着程澈，笑着说。“舅妈怎么样了？”程澈问。汜减汜“家里是待不下去了，我送她去了一个海边的小城市，她有朋友在那儿。”靳吾栖说，“你也知道，我妈性格本来就软弱，家里的事情她躲都来不及，现在我回来了，她肯定不能一个人留在那儿，她又不太愿意回国，考虑了很久，才选了那个地方，说适合养老。“为什么都不说？”程澈看着他，低低地开口，“如果不是爸爸妈妈告诉我，我都不知道外公那边闹成这样。”靳吾栖笑起来，抱着手往后靠在墙壁上，语气里几分调笑几分认真：“程大研究生，你的外公，我的爷爷，已经去世好几年了，我们两个之间只剩下表兄弟这一层关系了，我巴不得你永远别见识到我家里的那些狗屁亲戚。我跟你们有什么好说的呢，说出来了，除了让你们担心，什么好处都没有。”“破事儿再多，我也都解决完了，不是吗？”靳吾栖微微垂眼看着地面，笑了笑，“就是代价大了点。”阳光落在他颊边的碎发上，宛如晶莹的麦芒，剔透闪动。程澈顿了顿，看了眼手表，问：“中午一起吃饭吗？”“不了，就是来看看你，我等会儿要去找程宴，把红包当面给他，婚礼我不一定能出席。”&#29306&#22914&#32&#115&#117&#121&#105&#110&#103&#119&#97&#110&#103&#46&#110&#101&#116&#32&#29306&#22914“为什么？”程澈皱起眉，“叔叔不是要你当伴郎？”“他让我当我就当啊？”靳吾栖直起身子，茶色的瞳孔里盛着笑意，“我忙着呢，刚回来事情多，一直在国外，公司里很多东西都没交接上，想想就头疼。”芈何芈他说着就往电梯口走，见程澈还皱着眉，靳吾栖笑着拍拍他的肩：“看情况吧，我尽量去，好久没见你家小舟舟了，我也特别想他。”程澈看他一眼，想了想，还是没把“余炀”这个名字问出口。好啦，从这章开始，大家要评论就不用留“来了”之类的话啦，看完以后如果有啥想说的说说就行~喜欢长夏醒迟abo请大家收藏：长夏醒迟abo更新速度最快。
